newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shell stops sale of hard-core porn at Dutch pumps.
newsitem.headline: Shell stops sale of hard-core porn at Dutch pumps.

text.p: Oil giant Shell is to dent the liberal bedrock of Dutch society by stopping sales of hard-core pornographic magazines and videos at its Dutch service stations.
The new guideline comes into force on Saturday and is part of the company's strategy of diversifying into food sales.

"We have received complaints from customers and we have decided to introduce a new shop concept ... We expect more women, children and elderly customers and these groups would probably feel annoyed at this kind of material," a Shell spokesman said.
Devotees will still be able to buy the "softer" magazines Penthouse and Playboy.
"We feel these magazines are in general terms accepted in society," the Shell spokesman said.
